translations.en: It seemed to be fawning on you.
On the other hand, it could also look frightened.
Its remarkably small wings caught your eye.
A bird was carved into the door.
A small carving occupied the center.
A large carving occupied the center.
A small bird and a large bird were carved side by side.
An enormous bird...?
An eerie winged creature, clearly unlike any bird,
was carved into the door.
There was a statue of something
that might have been an enormous dragon.
Will you touch it?
It was a finely crafted statue.
If you could take it home, it would be worth a fortune.
You ignored the statue.
There was a decaying treasure chest.
Will you open the lid?
The bottom had fallen out of the chest.
You ignored the treasure chest.
There was a statue of a small dog.
It was an adorable dog with round, innocent eyes.
Yet countless kick marks covered its pedestal.
Statues of adorable dogs were packed tightly together.
There were so many that the sight felt uncanny.
They almost seemed to form some kind of magic circle.
A notice had been posted.
"Beware of the do..."
The last part was too faded to read.
A chain was tied to an old stake.
Its other end seemed to be buried in the ground.
Will you pull out the chain?
You tried to pull the chain free,
but something extremely heavy seemed to be attached.
When you pulled harder,
a rotting human face emerged, attached to a collar.
The rotting figure crawled the rest of the way out
and attacked you.
You decided to ignore the chain.
The power of a spell seemed to be blocking the way.
Going any farther would be dangerous.
It seemed you would have to dispel the magic somewhere.
You decided to turn back.
There was an extremely ornate switch.
You could no longer sense any magic from it.
It looked dangerous, and you could feel its magic.
Will you activate the switch?
The switch activated with a loud noise.
A powerful surge of magic shot from the switch!
You saw it streak through the air toward Area 6.
You decided to ignore the switch.
A mass of magical energy burst toward you!!
A large stone tablet stood there.
"Exit this way."
Jars and plates lay scattered around the tablet.
There was a large, broken stone tablet.
Something seemed to have been written on it,
but you could not read it.
You noticed a musty smell.
But it soon disappeared.
The room was filled with the smell of mold.
Yet it seemed to be only a musty smell,
with no particular danger to your health.
A large pile of what appeared to have been scrolls lay abandoned.
They all seemed ancient and had almost completely lost their shape.
You examined the pile
of what looked like scrolls.
All you seemed to accomplish was disturbing
the insects that had made their home there.
You found nothing.
You decided to ignore it.
You found a "Teleport Scroll" that still held magic.
You obtained a @3rTeleport Scroll@0r.
A musty smell came from the wall.
Could there be a gap somewhere?
There was an old treasure chest.
But before you could examine it,
you saw strange tentacles extending from a gap in the chest.
You sensed a fight coming.
Words were carved into a large rock.

fragment_policy: Listed rows preserve an unfinished source sentence across adjacent event records, an intervening label, or a deliberate interruption. Ordinary complete sentences restore the contextual subject and verb; unknown people remain gender-neutral.
